gpu.prep:
set -uo pipefail
cd "$V3_REPO_DIR" || { echo "prep: cd 失败"; exit 25; }
actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)"
[ "$actual" = "$V3_PIN_COMMIT" ] || { echo "prep: HEAD=$actual 与固定版本不符"; exit 27; }
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "prep: 工作树不干净"; git status --porcelain; exit 28; fi
"$V3_PY" -V || { echo "prep: 解释器不可用"; exit 29; }
nvidia-smi -L || echo "prep: WARN nvidia-smi 不可用"
df -h "$HOME" | tail -1
if "$V3_PY" -m v3.train.entry --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '--dest-dir'; then
  : > "$V3_RUN_DIR/dest_supported"
  echo "prep: 入口支持 --dest-dir"
else
  rm -f "$V3_RUN_DIR/dest_supported"
  echo "prep: 入口**不支持** --dest-dir —— adapter 会落到仓库内"
  exit 30
fi
gpu.main:
set -uo pipefail
cd "$V3_REPO_DIR" || exit 25
[ -f "$V3_RUN_DIR/dest_supported" ] || { echo "main: 入口不支持 --dest-dir，拒绝开训"; exit 30; }
EXTRA=()
[ -n "$V3_MEMORY_PROFILE" ] && EXTRA+=(--memory-profile "$V3_MEMORY_PROFILE")
[ -n "$V3_EXPORT_MANIFEST" ] && EXTRA+=(--export-manifest "$V3_EXPORT_MANIFEST")
exec "$V3_PY" -m v3.train.entry --start \
  --operator "$V3_OPERATOR" --gpu-hours "$V3_GPU_HOURS_ARG" --stage T1 \
  --v2-conflict-checked --dest-dir "$V3_RUN_DIR/adapter" \
  ${EXTRA[@]+"${EXTRA[@]}"}

cpu.main:
set -uo pipefail
cd "$V3_REPO_DIR" || exit 25
exec "$V3_PY" -m v3.train.entry "$V3_ENTRY_FLAG"
